citation: JACET (2016). New JACET List of 8,000 Basic Words.
notes: 2-column CSV: rank,Word. No POS, no inflected forms.
22 entries carry parenthetical variants (e.g. 'mom (mommy, mum, ...)') -> expanded to the head rank.
Spreadsheet artifacts: 'TRUE'/'FALSE' are the words true/false (restored by lower-casing).
Because the list is POS-less and one-entry-per-spelling, it is already flemma-grained.
